package.name: 2D Avatars
package.description: Shows your characters and personas as animated 2D avatars that blink, talk, and change faces with each reply. Uses your sprites or a mesh avatar file. Set up each avatar on the agent's page in Agents, then add the Agent in Chat Settings → Agents → Misc Agents for Roleplay and Game modes.
